title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (continued from p.299). S is a base scheme. F is a rank-2 vector bundle on S, so P(F) is a P^1-bundle. D_1 is a line subbundle, corresponding to the section x_0. The nilpotent N_1 has kernel and image D_1. ε_1 = 1+N_1 is the unipotent automorphism fixing D_1; its class in PGL(2) is a parabolic automorphism of the P^1-bundle fixing x_0. ρ̃, σ̃ are sections of PGL(2) = GP(1) ≃ GL(2)/G_m, i.e. automorphisms of P(F). They both send D_0 := ρ^{-1}D_1 = σ^{-1}D_1 to D_1 and satisfy ρ̃σ̃^{-1} = ε̃_1.

From (29)-(31) of the previous page, after twisting by D_1^{-1} we have F = O e_0 ⊕ O e_1, with D_0 = O e_0, D_1 = O e_1 and N_1 e_0 = e_1, N_1 e_1 = 0. This gives (32): N_1 = [[0,0],[1,0]] and ε_1 = [[1,0],[1,1]].

This page chooses lifts ρ, σ ∈ GL(2)(S) of ρ̃, σ̃. A crossed-out argument explains why a lift of ρ̃σ̃^{-1} can be normalised to -ε_1. Any lift of ε̃_1 is a scalar times ε_1, so it acts by the same scalar on D_1 and on F/D_1. One may therefore impose that it be -1 on D_1, and then it is -1 on F/D_1 as well. This gives the boxed normalisation (33): ρσ^{-1} = -ε_1. It fixes σ in terms of ρ (and conversely), leaving one common scalar ambiguity.

Since ρD_0 = D_1, we have ρe_0 ∈ O e_1, so ρ = [[0,u],[v,w]] with det ρ = -uv a unit. The common scalar is removed by setting u = 1, giving (34): ρ = [[0,1],[v,w]].

Check using the next page. σ = -ε_1^{-1}ρ = -(1-N_1)ρ. Since N_1ρ = [[0,0],[0,u]], we get σ = [[0,-u],[-v,u-w]]. Hence ρ+σ = N_1ρ = diag(0,u), and N^2 = N exactly when u = 1. Also Tr ρ + Tr σ = u (= 1 after normalisation).

Purpose: this is an explicit 'épinglage' (rigidification) of a pair of PGL_2-automorphisms of a P^1-bundle whose quotient is a given parabolic element. It parametrises such pairs by the matrix entries (v, w), as part of the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' (rank-2 linear models of the loop relations). The page does not show the larger aim explicitly.
errors: No mathematical error found. All formulas check: (32); (33) is consistent with the crossed-out eigenvalue argument; (*) gives det = -uv; and with (34), σ = [[0,-1],[-v,1-w]] as on the next page.
Minor: the choice of the sign -1 rather than +1 in (33) is a convention, not forced; it is chosen so that ρ+σ becomes the idempotent diag(0,1) on the next page.

ideas.what: Lifting a PGL_2 relation ρ̃σ̃^{-1} = ε̃_1 (parabolic) to GL_2, with the scalar fixed by its eigenvalue on the fixed line, giving ρσ^{-1} = -ε_1
ideas.modern_name: lifting projective representations from PGL_2 to GL_2 (sign/scalar normalisation of a parabolic element)

ideas.what: Normal form ρ = [[0,1],[v,w]] for an automorphism sending D_0 to D_1, in an adapted basis of a split rank-2 bundle
ideas.modern_name: rigidified (épinglé) normal form for a pair of rank-2 automorphisms

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine explicit linear algebra: a normalisation of matrix lifts in GL_2 of PGL_2 data within a larger, unpublished computation. It is correct, but nothing here would be new to a specialist; any interest lies in the global context of the 'équation des lacets' manuscript, not in this page.
transcription_corrections: Marginal text: 'Nous choisissons ρ, σ (sections de GL(2)) au dessus de ρ̃, σ̃ (sections de GP(1) ≃ GL(2)/G_m) satisfaisant ρ̃σ̃^{-1} = ε̃_1'. The word is 'sections', not 'relèvements', and the right-hand side is ε̃_1 (with tilde).

The crossed-out block reads roughly: 'ρD_0 = σD_0 = D_1, ce qui s'exprime aussi par ρσ^{-1}(D_1) = D_1, et on a supposé ρ, σ de telle façon que ρσ^{-1}|D_1 = -1, ce qui compte tenu de ρ̃σ̃^{-1} = ε_1 implique que ρσ^{-1}|(F/D_1) = -1, i.e.' followed by (33).
'déterminées qu'elles sont modulo un scalaire, ou {+lorsque+} ... de σ̃ resp. de ρ̃' — the struck word may be 'fonction'; the reading is uncertain.

'et on peut lever l'ambiguïté scalaire sur ρ en normalisant par (34) ρ = [[0,1],[v,w]]'. The final marginal text after (34) is illegible; it may say that v (and w) are sections of O_S, with v invertible.
